conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you. What do you hope to get out of your appointment? Please include anything else you would like help with.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly I want to worry less and be able to sleep without lying awake for hours.

conversation.message: I mean any other psychiatric diagnosis that a mental health professional has given you or mentioned—for example, depression, OCD, or bipolar disorder. Are there any others besides generalized anxiety disorder?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, just generalized anxiety.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health reasons?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
